notes: torn api: [1] User ID not required when requesting the key's owner data. [2] Accepts comma separated selections. [3] 'from' and 'to' UNIX timestamps can be passed to filter some selections

tornlog.py: we need to first collect the ENTIRETY of the users logs, and store the server-time timestamps in _dir/data/user.json, and any future runs should compare a current timestamp with the most recent one in the user.json, then only request the data between those two, and when done, update the json with the new server-time timestamp
